name: uberasm-fade-from-credits-to-title-screen
title: Fade from Credits to Title Screen
description:
This UberASM code allows the player to return from the credits to the title screen.
I included four possible points of return:
  1. After the credits roll: insert in game mode 1C.
  2. After Yoshi's House "Thank You!" message: insert in game mode 20.
  3. After the enemy credits: insert in game mode 26.
  4. After the "THE END" screen: insert in game mode 29.

Compatible with Kevin's Credits Utilities (and indeed, meant to be used with it): insert said code in game mode 19 to use it with this!

Requested by Bourbaki.
